description: A Java class defining a custom Swing component 'LabelWithEditLink' that displays a label with an 'edit' link, allowing toggling between display and edit modes.

classes.name: LabelWithEditLink
classes.description: A Swing component extending JPanel that displays a label with an 'edit' link, enabling inline editing of text.

methods.name: LabelWithEditLink
methods.description: Constructor initializing the component, setting up layout, labels, and mouse listener for toggling edit mode.

methods.name: toggleEdit
methods.description: Toggles between display and edit modes, updating labels and focus accordingly.

methods.name: setText
methods.description: Sets the text of the label and edit field.

methods.name: getText
methods.description: Retrieves the current text from the edit field or label.

methods.name: setFont
methods.description: Sets the font for the component and its labels, adjusting font size for the edit label.

methods.name: getDocument
methods.description: Returns the document model of the edit text field.
